correctness.rationale: The proof fixes the quotient via the distinct full-wild and tame-cubic branch types, then shows any allowed scaling acts nontrivially on the first Artin–Schreier coordinate unless the scaling is identity. This is proved by the even pole order of h^2+h at a pole of h. Characteristic-two length-two Witt addition/inversion gives f_lambda-f_mu=(0,(lambda+mu)t) and f_lambda+f_mu=(0,(lambda+mu)t+t^2), so equivalence modulo the two units of Z/4 is exactly mu=lambda or lambda+1. The normalizer is the kernel of its now-trivial quotient action and hence the deck group C12. Every nonempty pair-isomorphism set is a torsor of size 12. The C4 different, tame cubic base change, degree and genus are recomputed for every parameter; the GF(16) checker verifies finite instances but the algebraic proof handles all fields/parameters.

value.rationale: Completes the precise geometric isomorphism classification left open by the 2026 genus-six C12 family statement, with the natural affine invariant j=lambda^2+lambda; in addition every distinguished deck group is self-normalizing and every nonempty pair-isomorphism set has exactly 12 arrows. This is a natural complete action-moduli invariant useful for analyzing Hurwitz loci and group embeddings, not a small arbitrary numerical experiment. It deliberately makes no stronger assertion about full automorphism groups or unmarked curves.
